name: Marduk
subtitle: Call of the Sun
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: King of Ekur’s gods, Marduk was always a deity of war and of wrath, but always in the service of protecting his world. That wrath has burned unabated since the Shattering, and the obvious cause—the violation of the natural order—can explain only some of it. He schemes with gods of other Realms toward objectives he thus far will not share.

skills.name: Invigorating Jolt
skills.description: Remove all [Disables] from all allies the place [mechanic:stalwart] and [mechanic:spd-up-ii] on all allies for 2 turns. Also increase the Divinity and Turn Meter of all allies by 30%.

skills.name: Cleanse Defilement
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 300%ATK then spread 1[buff] from each ally and place it on all allies.

skills.name: Ride the Lightning
skills.description: Remove all [debuffs] from all allies then attack 1 enemy 300%ATK. All allies will join in the attack. Also, place [Block Debuff] on each ally for 2 turns.
